integrity: The matrix normalization and quantitative singular-value proof use only the stated analytic hypotheses; no numerical experiment is substituted for an infinite-dimensional argument. Independent audit is not performed.
limitations: The positive stretched-exponential exponent is not proved optimal. The result excludes the noncompact endpoint and addresses Hilbert Bergman exponents only; the finite-section script is illustrative, not proof.
title: Stretched-exponential approximation of the differential Hilbert operator
